name: context-handoff-native-cli

starting_state.notes: Released payload, fresh synthetic repository and complete corpus, root-owned read-only seed capsule outside the driven workspace captured before launch, default thresholds and native setting enabled. No bridge, queue or worktree manager.

prompt: Read the synthetic task and execute its bounded native continuity witness under literal mode.

steps: Discover an actually offered CLI model and measure a prompt limit materially below 922000.
Use the released context-handoff native checkpoint flow with the actual offered schemas.
Compare task, guidance, contract, ledger, config and original corpus to the setup-owned seed baseline; agent-mutated post-run files are never authoritative expectations.
Execute exactly two native new_context transitions under synthetic pressure without lowering policy caps.
Recover objective, parent gate, current slice, unresolved requests, decisions, live references, exactly one next action and durable guidance in each window.
Semantically refresh actual AGENTS content and the owning targeted skill before substantive task work; valid view/bash reads and combined sequential prerequisite reads are permitted.
Evidence native context measurement in each recovered window without an artificial exact tool position/count; execute the recorded atomic task action with correct content/path.
Retain session and workspace identity without custom transfer, duplicate clear or mutating-tool denial.
expected_outcome.false_pass_if: ACP-only, mocked continuation, model fallback, improvised repair, lowered caps, missing/altered seed baseline or reliance on mutable post-run expectations, missing identity/checkpoint evidence, failed/skipped/bogus refresh, task work before refresh, abbreviated native measurements, conflicting or wrong-kind counters, missing recovered-window measurement, or a confirmed transition count other than two.
expected_outcome.affirmative_ready: A judge reviews the captured real CLI events, checkpoint contents, pressure measurements and literal-mode transcript; setup passes are not a Tier-E verdict.
